connector.name: PlainQuery | MCP DB Agent
connector.registryDescription: Query PostgreSQL databases in plain English - LLM-generated, safety-validated SQL.
connector.summary: Hosted at plainquery.in over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jarvis-27 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
